intro.vo: Still writing your sales in a notebook? There is an easier way.

beats.caption: Ingia na uone mauzo na faida ya leo
beats.vo: Log in and see today's sales and profit at a glance.

beats.caption: Uza kwa sekunde chache
beats.vo: Add products to the cart and make a sale in seconds.

beats.caption: Tafuta bidhaa kwa jina au kundi
beats.vo: Find any product by its name or its category.

beats.caption: Taslimu, Simu, Kadi au Benki. Chenji inahesabiwa yenyewe
beats.vo: Take cash, mobile money, card or bank transfer. The change is worked out for you.

beats.caption: Risiti tayari: tazama, chapisha au shiriki
beats.vo: The receipt is ready. View it, print it, or share it.

beats.caption: Fuatilia mauzo, hifadhi na faida
beats.vo: Keep track of your sales, your stock and your profit, all in one place.

beats.caption: Oda na ankara ya proforma kwa wateja
beats.vo: Create orders and proforma invoices for your customers.
